title: Agentivity Guard Report (I-462)
description: Shape of the list returned by coderain.validator.scan_missing_origin(store) — one entry per managed-registry entry (store.gated_registries() + threads.md) whose `origin` attr is absent or not one of player/narrator/inferred. See docs/garde-agentivite-i462.md for the D-107 provenance rule this report enforces. Deliberately excludes any field that could name the entry's content (title, body, aliases) — `registry` + `slug` only, so the report is safe to log at any verbosity.

registry.description: The managed registry file the entry lives in (MemoryStore.gated_registries(), plus threads.md).

slug.description: The entry's stable slug — an identifier, not a spoiler by itself.
